author: Hermes
question: A transformer delivers maximum efficiency at a certain load. Which condition holds at that load?
solution: Efficiency is maximum when the variable loss (copper loss, which varies with load squared) equals the constant loss (iron/core loss). Differentiating efficiency with respect to load current gives this condition. Topic (transformers) is in the Electrical Machines section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
